topic: A person learns their apartment building is going condo
text: I should have seen the signs. Whispers in the hallway, the sudden meetings, the broker's car parked too often outside. Now, the notice stares back, cold and final. What will become of the quiet evenings, the borrowed cups of sugar, the familiar faces that make this place feel like home? I can't help but think of the times I hesitated, when a kind word or a helping hand was needed, and I stayed silent, stayed back. Now, the building's heartbeat is changing, and I'm just another tenant caught in the turn. I should do more, say more, be more. But it's hard, standing in the shadow of change, wondering if I made a difference, if I'll be remembered.
